visual.general_description: Twelve-panel renal tumor microscopy and immunohistochemical composite.
visual.detailed_description: Four rows of three panels on a white background with thin dark panel borders and bold visible letters A–L. Rows are A/B/C, D/E/F, G/H/I, J/K/L. A–H show pink/purple cellular tissue; I and L have broad brown staining, J has brown background bands and K is predominantly pale-blue. Colored arrows appear in D/E/G/H. No rulers, magnification labels, numeric scores or antigen labels are printed within the fields.

panels.general_description: Pink/purple cellular tissue with broad closely packed nests and sheets.
panels.detailed_description: Upper-left panel A shows a broad pink/purple microscopic field. Many round/oval blue-purple nuclei occupy pale-pink cellular profiles with visible outlines, interrupted by paler rounded areas and narrow red/pink vessel-like structures. No arrows or quantitative overlays are present.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Colored magnified tissue field with cellular and nuclear profiles.
